summary: Planned ~240,000-sq-ft, 250-room waterfront hotel site around the Stack and the Unit 3 Power Block (partly demolished in 2023-24; the D4D provides for the hotel with or without Unit 3); the Chronicle reported in May 2025 that the hotel's construction 'could be a decade away' and that the developer proposed an interim park (Prequel Park) on the land instead.

milestones.text: Port memo (Item 13B) describes the project's program; SF Planning's project page lists a 240,000 sq ft hotel (250 rooms) in that program

Chronicle reports the hotel approved for this site is slowed by the sluggish recovery of San Francisco's hospitality sector ('the hotel's construction could be a decade away', the reporter's words), and that the developer, Enrique Landa, proposes an interim waterfront park (Prequel Park) around the stack in the meantime

Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement that first names Block 9 as a development block under the adopted Design for Development's Land Use Table; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date

facts.value: Hotel and/or Residential (D4D final Table 3.1.1: Residential is Permitted; Hotel is Permitted per note 10, unlike most other blocks where Hotel is Not Permitted; Laboratory and Life Science uses are Not Permitted)

The D4D final's Figure 6.2.3 shows a separate 'Block 9 Building Configurations' inset with two alternate massings. By its colour-coded labels, 'with Unit 3' is 85 ft, 65 ft and 35 ft plus Unit 3 itself at about 130 ft ('~130''), and 'without Unit 3' is 125 ft and 85 ft. The '177'MAX', '110'MAX' and '102'MAX' labels are dimension lines (plan extents), not heights. Standard 6.2.1 separately states that if Unit 3 is demolished, the height limit for Block 9 would be 125/85 feet

As described in the 2018 Draft EIR (before Unit 3's abatement and partial demolition, June 2023 to July 2024, per the 2024 annual compliance report): Unit 3 Power Block (128-ft tall steel-frame boiler structure, highest point 143 ft at the elevator shaft, plus a 40-ft tall turbine-generator-condenser structure and a four-story concrete control room building) and the adjacent 300-ft Boiler Stack (mapped separately in this dataset as potrero_the_stack)

'Only one rooftop bar shall be permitted on Block 9' under the adopted D4D (Table 3.1.1, note 10); note 7 separately allows rooftop bars on Blocks 2, 3, 11, 12 and 15. The Chronicle (July 29, 2026) describes a rule 'limiting the entire 29-acre development to a single rooftop bar' that the developer asked to eliminate in its 2026 Development Agreement amendment request; the source of that project-wide cap is not identified in the sources found

open_questions: No source found stating a developer, architect, hotel brand/operator, or construction cost for the Block 9 hotel.

No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 9; the 2024 annual compliance report's only mention of Block 9 is site photos of 'Block 9 / Unit 3' as of December 2024, with no described construction activity.
Whether Unit 3 will ultimately be retained or demolished as part of the hotel project is not settled in any source found; the D4D provides for both configurations.

No current schedule found for the Block 9 hotel. SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table lists Block 9 in Phase 2 with vertical development 2029-2030, but the Chronicle (May 2025) reported the hotel's construction could be a decade away, so no completion year is shown; the earlier 2035 expected-completion milestone was removed on 2026-09-29 because the source refers to a possible construction start about a decade out, not a completion, and to the reporter's words, not the developer's.
